column_definitions: Average log-normalized gene expression (counts per million + 1) across all cells in this data set.
log2 fold change comparing the mean CPM of postnatal observations at P40 or older with the mean CPM of all embryonic observations.
log2 fold change comparing the mean CPM of postnatal observations at P40 or older with the mean CPM of all embryonic observations after excluding zero values within each group.
The brain region-of-interest (ROI) label with the highest mean CPM.
Log2 fold change of the maximum region of interest (ROI) mean relative to the arithmetic mean of ROI-level means.
Log2 fold change of the maximum region of interest (ROI) mean relative to the arithmetic mean of ROI-level means after excluding zero observations.
The subclass with the highest mean CPM.
Log2 fold change of the maximum subclass mean relative to the arithmetic mean of subclass-level means.
Log2 fold change of the maximum subclass mean relative to the arithmetic mean of subclass-level means after excluding zero observations.
